dataLoss: No seeded entitlement, legacy IPN-event, or bot rows were deleted. However, all six paid/non-BASIC synthetic rows became effectively BASIC through revoked_at_ms; this is six access-loss cases, including one with signed finished legacy IPN evidence. No expiry or provider-order record can be reconstructed from this migration alone.
limitations: The pre-0016 schema cannot represent an entitlement with expires_at_ms/current_payment_id, a payment-order row, or a prior explicit revoked flag. The signed-finished legacy IPN is evidence of a callback, not sufficient proof of an active unexpired subscription. The exact hypothetical paid-valid-with-expiry case is therefore impossible to seed as a legacy row without changing the old schema or pre-granting post-migration state. In this synthetic set, 6 owner memberships were created for legacy owner IDs absent from users; confirm such owners against users/sessions before any migration, while noting absence of a users row alone does not demonstrate a real session or accessible account.
